required_source_target_roles.logical_host_role: R1 logical host attribution; unresolved values remain UNKNOWN

run_id_raw_key_binding.canonical_encoding: length-prefixed UTF-8 fields in the listed order
run_id_raw_key_binding.collision_policy: fail closed on duplicate or mismatched binding
run_id_raw_key_binding.reverse_fields: retain the canonical fields in the run manifest; fingerprint is an integrity check, not the sole identifier

timeout_error_semantics.error: return ERROR with a controlled code and preserve the unexecuted result state
timeout_error_semantics.telemetry_missing: return BLOCKED and invalidate equivalence claim
timeout_error_semantics.timeout: return BLOCKED or ERROR with timeout code; never infer an outcome
timeout_error_semantics.unexpected_state: return ERROR and require reset review
